hints.title: Work Backwards
hints.text: Instead of moving from 1 to target, work backwards from target down to 1.

hints.title: Greedy Halving
hints.text: Whenever target is even and double operations remain, divide by two. If target is odd, decrement by one.

hints.title: Direct Jump When Doubling Exhausted
hints.text: When maxDoubles reaches zero, all remaining steps to reach 1 must be subtractions of one, taking target minus 1 moves.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.time: O(N) single pass or optimal algorithmic traversal
variables: N: input size or row count
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Breadth-first search forward from 1 has an exponential search tree up to target 10^9.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Backward halving executes in O(log target) time with O(1) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Reverse perspective and optimize the zero-doubles remaining condition directly.
